hidden_nurse_d2_low.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_low.text: *When you open the nurse's office door, the school nurse closes the chart.* Unless you need treatment, I can't talk for long right now. Go back to class.

after2_start.name: {name}
after2_start.text: *After school. Two notifications are waiting on my phone.*

after2_msg_dain.name: Dain
after2_msg_dain.text: Come to the gym. Today's bet is for real.

after2_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
after2_msg_seo.text: Can you swing by the council room? I'm short-handed.

after2_msg_yuna.name: {name}
after2_msg_yuna.text: *I haven't heard from Yuna. As I pack my bag, the note from this morning slips out of my pocket. The words 'Library annex' straddle the crease.*

after2_nurse_transition.name: {name}
after2_nurse_transition.text: *After fifth-period PE, the edge of the bandage catches on my sleeve. I press it down once, but it lifts again.*

hidden_nurse_d2_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_1.text: *When I roll up my sleeve, one side of the bandage is peeling up. The wound isn't bleeding anymore.*

hidden_nurse_d2_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_2.text: That bandage came back before the day was even over. Have a seat.

hidden_nurse_d2_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_3.text: The edge keeps catching on my sleeve.

hidden_nurse_d2_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_5.text: *She removes the loose bandage, cleans around the wound, and takes out a fresh one.* This might sting a little.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.text: *The nurse bends and straightens my elbow, measuring how long the bandage should be.*
choices: Did you learn things like this at the hospital?
You're meticulous even with a bandage.
You only take this much care with me, right?
Getting hurt doesn’t seem so bad if you’re the one treating me.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.text: Yeah. Over a joint, you have to apply it so movement won't peel it off.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.text: It's my job. If I slap it on carelessly and it falls off in class, that's a problem.

hidden_nurse_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_6.text: *The nurse throws away the new bandage wrapper. The drawer she shut earlier stays closed.*

hidden_nurse_d2_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_7.text: *She notices my glance and rests a hand on the handle.* That subject is closed. Curiosity won’t open it.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.text: *The knuckles gripping the drawer handle are white.*
choices: You sure have a lot of secrets. Can't you tell me just one?
Right, I didn't see anything
If it’s your secret, I promise I’ll keep it.
You can tell me everything.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.text: *She taps the drawer.* Knowing about the cocoa is enough. No second secret.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.text: *She lets go of the drawer handle.* A secret. That's enough, right?

hidden_nurse_d2_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_8.text: All done. Keep it dry today.

after2_choice.name: {name}
choices: To the gym (Dain)
To the student council room (Seoyeon)
Stop by the library annex (Yuna)

after2_dain_1.name: {name}
after2_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is doing warm-ups in front of the volleyball net.*

after2_dain_4.name: Dain
after2_dain_4.text: I got here ten minutes early!

after2_dain_5.name: {name}
after2_dain_5.text: *You're the one who came early. I wasn't late.*

after2_dain_6.name: Dain
after2_dain_6.text: Okay, deal! Five serves — clear the net at least three times and you win! Lose, and you're buying tteokbokki!

after2_dain_9.name: {name}
after2_dain_9.text: *The first serve catches the net. The second lands inside the line.*

after2_dain_9_b.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_b.text: *She catches the rebounding ball in both hands.* Huh? I was going to go easy on you, but never mind.

after2_dain_9_c.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_c.text: *She lowers her stance and tightens her grip on the ball.*

after2_dain_9_d.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_d.text: Okay, serving practice is over! Now rallies—first to three!

after2_dain_9_e.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_e.text: *The rally speeds up. Every time Dain lands, her left foot comes down first and her right follows half a beat later.*

after2_dain_9_f.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_f.text: *The scoreboard reads 3–2. As Dain stands, she rubs her right knee once, then uses the same hand to flip the scorecard.*

after2_dain_11b.name: {name}
after2_dain_11b.text: *We left the gym and walked down the street.*

after2_dain_12.name: Dain
after2_dain_12.text: I lost. But wait, you're pretty good! Didn't you say you don't play sports?

after2_dain_14.name: Dain
after2_dain_14.text: *She drops the ball in her hands.* What? Did you trick me?

after2_dain_15.name: {name}
after2_dain_15.text: Didn't hustle you. You just never asked.

after2_dain_16.name: Dain
after2_dain_16.text: *She raises a fist to shoulder height, then tucks it against her own side.* You fraud. But hey, that was fun!

after2_dain_skinship_1.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_1.text: *Our palms meet. Dain shouts, “Nice!” and only then lets go.*

after2_dain_skinship_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_2.text: Oh, did that sting? Should’ve held back a little.

after2_dain_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_skinship_3.text: *Dain rubs the palm that just met mine against the side seam of her track pants.*

after2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after2_dain_freetalk.text: *After we step into the shop, she pushes the tteokbokki cup closer and lifts her chopsticks.* Let's see how well you handle spicy food.

after2_dain_end_first.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_first.text: *Dain sets down two cups of tteokbokki with a thump and tears open the chopstick wrapper.*

after2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_b.text: *The tteokbokki place near school. Dain blows on her tteokbokki and talks.*

after2_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2.text: Hey — you really DO know sports, huh?

after2_dain_end_2c.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2c.text: 'A little' doesn't move like that! — Just own it, you're good.

after2_dain_end_2d.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_2d.text: You were way better than me.

after2_dain_end_3.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3.text: *The tips of her chopsticks stay suspended over the tteokbokki.*

after2_dain_end_3b.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3b.text: Of course. I was a recruited athlete, you know.

after2_dain_end_3c.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3c.text: *As soon as “was” leaves her mouth, Dain's chopsticks move from the paper cup to the water beside it.*

after2_dain_end_3e.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3e.text: *She pushes the tteokbokki toward {name} and shakes the empty water bottle upside down.*

after2_dain_rival_seo_high.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_seo_high.text: *Beyond the snack bar window, Seoyeon stops. After seeing the two tteokbokki cups on the table, she sends a short message. 'So you were at the gym today. Stop by the student council room next time, too.'*

after2_dain_rival_seo_mid.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_seo_mid.text: *Seoyeon passes the snack bar and looks at the table. She squares the edges of her clipboard twice, then heads for the school gate.*

after2_dain_rival_seo_low.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_seo_low.text: *As Seoyeon passes the snack bar, she nods to both of us without breaking stride.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_high.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_high.text: *Yuna looks through the snack bar window. She puts the folded note in her hand back into her pocket and turns away.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_mid.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_mid.text: *Passing the snack bar, Yuna starts to remove one earbud, sees our table, and puts it back in.*

after2_dain_rival_yuna_low.name: {name}
after2_dain_rival_yuna_low.text: *Yuna gives us one nod through the window and continues toward the annex.*

after2_dain_return.name: {name}
after2_dain_return.text: *On the way back to school, we reach the front gate.*

after2_seo_1.name: {name}
after2_seo_1.text: *In the student council room, Seoyeon sits alone before a stack of documents.*

after2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_2.text: You actually came. — Honestly, I figured you wouldn't.

after2_seo_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_3.text: I show up when someone calls.

after2_seo_4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_4_b.text: *She turns the clipboard toward {name}. The top of the to-do list is blank.*

after2_seo_5.name: {name}
after2_seo_5.text: You're the one who asked for help.

after2_seo_6_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_6_b.text: *We start sorting documents. Event budgets, club applications. Quite the pile.*

after2_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8.text: These go by date, those by club. — Are you any good at organizing?

after2_seo_8a2.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a2.text: Not great, but not bad either.

after2_seo_8a4.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a4.text: Kind of like the way you compliment people. Vague.

after2_seo_8b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b.text: *She lifts her eyes from the documents and looks toward {name}.*

after2_seo_8b2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b2.text: You’re quicker at this than I expected.

after2_seo_8b4.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4.text: It's a compliment. Take the win.

after2_seo_8b4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4_b.text: *She calls it a compliment and immediately goes back to the paperwork. When she rolls her neck, she tugs at her shirt collar once.*

after2_seo_choice1.name: {name}
after2_seo_choice1.text: *An orange stripe of light slips through the blind and cuts across the documents. Seoyeon squares the corners of the pages.*
choices: The sunset's nice. — I mean the view, of course.
If you do this every day, you must be used to it.
Don’t struggle on your own. Want me to finish it for you?
That’s enough. Do the rest tomorrow.

after2_seo_sunset_joke.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_joke.text: *Her glasses slide slightly down her nose, and the tip of her pen slips out of the date box.*

after2_seo_sunset_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react.text: …Adding that only makes it sound more suspicious.

after2_seo_neck_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_react.text: *She rolls one shoulder and draws a small breath.*

after2_seo_neck_react_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react_c.text: *I slide one of the empty file boxes stacked nearby toward Seoyeon.*

after2_seo_neck_touch.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_touch.text: You want to use that as a stand?

after2_seo_neck_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high.text: It's an empty box. You only get one neck.

after2_seo_neck_high_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_c.text: *Seoyeon sets her papers on top of the file box. She doesn't have to tilt her head quite as far.*

after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.text: *Seoyeon leaves the file box where it is. We go back to sorting the papers by date.*

after2_seo_neck_low.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low.text: *She sets the file box on the edge of the desk between us.*

after2_seo_neck_low_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low_b.text: Never mind if you don't want it.

after2_seo_neck_low_c.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_c.text: *She takes the box and sets it beside the papers.*

after2_seo_neck_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_2.text: I'll try it when we're done.

after2_seo_9.name: {name}
after2_seo_9.text: *By the time the blind's shadow stretches to the edge of the desk, the paperwork is almost finished.*

after2_seo_choice2.name: {name}
choices: Should I stay a bit longer? Seems like there's still some left
If we're done, I'll head out
You can finish this much on your own, right?

after2_seo_choice2_trap.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_choice2_trap.text: *She pulls the stack of papers toward herself.* Sure. It was my work to begin with.

after2_seo_stay.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay.text: *She sets down the papers and raises the blind by one slat.*

after2_seo_stay_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_2.text: I like how quiet it is at this hour.

after2_seo_stay_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3.text: Even the council president gets time off?

after2_seo_stay_3b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_3b.text: I’m about to take a break.

after2_seo_stay_3c.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3c.text: *Seoyeon's clipboard lies face down on the desk, with only the last sheet of paperwork beside it.*

after2_seo_leave.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_leave.text: *She presses the finished stack flat with both hands, squaring its edges.*

after2_seo_skinship_1.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_1.text: *She reaches out and picks a speck of dust from my collar. Her hand brushes my neck.*

after2_seo_skinship_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_2.text: *Her fingers stay against my collar. Only after the wheels of a cleaning cart pass down the hall does she pull her hand away.*

after2_seo_skinship_3.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_3.text: You had some dust on you.

after2_seo_return.name: {name}
after2_seo_return.text: *I leave the student council room and head toward the front gate.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_high.text: *Pushing a cart of gym balls, Dain sees us at the end of the hall.* Student council work took a while. *She grips the handle and turns away first.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_mid.text: *She stops the ball cart.* Done? *She glances at Seoyeon, then pushes the cart back toward the gym.*

after2_seo_rival_dain_low.name: Dain
after2_seo_rival_dain_low.text: Good work! *She waves over the ball cart and heads toward the gym.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_high.text: *Reading on the stair landing, Yuna closes her book when she hears us. She pulls out the note tucked between the pages and folds it in half.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_mid.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_mid.text: *Yuna's hand stops on the page. She shifts aside to let us pass, then opens the book again.*

after2_seo_rival_yuna_low.name: {name}
after2_seo_rival_yuna_low.text: *Yuna steps aside on the landing and gives us a brief nod.*

after2_yuna_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1.text: *No message from Yuna. Still, my feet head toward the library. The folded note in my pocket brushes against the back of my hand with every step.*

after2_yuna_1_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1_b.text: *The annex hall is deserted. Only the door to the secret reading room stands open by two finger widths.*

after2_yuna_2.name: {name}
after2_yuna_2.text: *The old hinge gives a short cry when I push the door. Yuna is reading on the sofa, and the window-frame shadow has reached the spine of her book.*

after2_yuna_2_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_2_b.text: *She moves one earbud resting on top of her book out of the way.*

after2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_5.text: Do I have to call for you to show up?

after2_yuna_6.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_6.text: *Her index finger traces the same sentence twice.*

after2_yuna_8b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8b.text: *One earbud is already waiting on the chair inside. Yuna points to the cushion beside her with her chin.*

after2_yuna_8d.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8d.text: *A quiet piano piece plays through the earbuds. Yuna reads while the cord on my side stretches taut through the gap in the sofa.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre1.text: *She works a knot out of the earbud cord once as she speaks.* Anyone who comes here after school.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3.text: No one has, since that senior.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.text: *Yuna looks directly at {name} over the top of her book. The earbud cord stays wound tight around her fingers.*

after2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after2_yuna_choice.text: *The earbud cord winds once more between Yuna's fingers.*
choices: Should I come every day?
It's nice because it's quiet.
I like how empty it is here. I would feel comfortable with anyone.

after2_yuna_everyday.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday.text: *She untangles the earbud cord, then winds it around her index finger again.*

after2_yuna_everyday_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_b.text: Come if you want. I won't stop you.

after2_yuna_everyday_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_react.text: Every day would be a bit much, though. Just sometimes.

after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.text: *Yuna keeps the bookmark in and stays on the same page.*

after2_yuna_quiet.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_quiet.text: That's why I like it here.

after2_yuna_quiet_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_quiet_react.text: *Her bookmark moves back one page. She doesn't clear away the earbud at the end of the sofa.*

after2_yuna_end.name: {name}
after2_yuna_end.text: *It’s time to close our books. I pull my bag closer while Yuna gathers her things from the sofa.*

after2_yuna_skinship_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_1.text: *We reach for the same book — and our hands overlap.*

after2_yuna_skinship_2.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_skinship_2.text: *Three seconds pass with the corner of the book pressed over our overlapping hands. Only then does Yuna pull hers away.*

after2_yuna_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_3.text: *After pulling her hand away, Yuna turns the book so its spine faces me and passes it over.*

after2_yuna_return.name: {name}
after2_yuna_return.text: *When I leave the library annex, the hall's automatic lights come on.*

after2_yuna_rival_dain_high.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_high.text: I told you to come to the gym, and you went to the annex. Come my way next time, too.

after2_yuna_rival_dain_mid.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_mid.text: You were at the library? Stop by the gym tomorrow.

after2_yuna_rival_dain_low.name: Dain
after2_yuna_rival_dain_low.text: You were near the library? See you tomorrow!

after2_yuna_rival_seo_high.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_high.text: So you were in the annex. Stop by the student council room next time, too.

after2_yuna_rival_seo_mid.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_mid.text: You were in the annex. I finished today's work. See you tomorrow.

after2_yuna_rival_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after2_yuna_rival_seo_low.text: I found enough help. See you tomorrow.

after2_group_seoyeon_companion.name: Seoyeon and companion
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.text: *We return to the student council room to check the time left for cleanup. Seoyeon taps two overlapping schedule blocks with one finger. The person across from her refuses to yield.* "We both need your help. Who are you going to help first?"
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.context: While the protagonist and Seoyeon are sorting the after-school schedule, the other character with the highest affinity arrives with a schedule or request of their own. Student-council work overlaps with another school activity, and the three of them must settle it. Seoyeon clearly asks whom the protagonist will help first.
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.personality: It looks like a small scheduling issue, but both characters are conscious of the protagonist's priority. Keep it from turning into open hostility or humiliation. If the protagonist dodges, each presses for an answer in their own way. If one is chosen, the other does not force a cheerful shrug.
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.groupChoiceState: Seoyeon's schedule overlaps with the companion's request, and the protagonist must say whom he will help first
after2_group_seoyeon_companion.groupAftermathCause: whom the protagonist chose to help first in the student council room, and why

after2_group_yuna_companion.name: Yuna and companion
after2_group_yuna_companion.text: *We return to the annex and lay out the materials to sort. There are two stacks to sort, but barely enough time to finish one. Yuna removes one earbud and looks across the table.* "If you can only finish one with us, who will you stay with?"
after2_group_yuna_companion.context: While the protagonist and Yuna sort material in the library annex, the other character with the highest affinity arrives with separate material or an urgent request. There is only enough time to finish one side properly. Yuna asks, briefly and directly, whom the protagonist will stay beside.
after2_group_yuna_companion.personality: Yuna demands a short, exact choice, while the companion holds their ground in their own voice. Do not force a reconciliation or instantly invent a solution that satisfies both. Let the answer bring relief to one person and disappointment to the other when appropriate.
after2_group_yuna_companion.groupChoiceState: there is time to sort only one of two stacks, so the protagonist must say whose side he will stay on
after2_group_yuna_companion.groupAftermathCause: whose side the protagonist chose in the library annex, and why

after2_group_dain_companion.name: Dain and companion
after2_group_dain_companion.text: *We return to the gym for the ball cart. Our companion says the storage attendant asked for festival materials first. Dain grips the cart.* “I heard balls first. Which instruction will you check first?”
after2_group_dain_companion.context: On the way out, they returned to the gym with Dain to return the ball cart. The companion was asked by the storage attendant to bring festival materials first; Dain heard balls first. Only the order conflicts, with no accident or established liar. With little time left, the player must say whose instruction to verify and help with first.
after2_group_dain_companion.personality: Do not invent a serious accident or malicious lie. The point is not a mystery's objective solution, but whose word the protagonist trusts first. Dain presses honestly, and the companion does not withdraw into a supporting role. Let one person be hurt by the answer when that fits.
after2_group_dain_companion.groupChoiceState: Decide whose instruction to verify and whether to return the ball cart or festival materials first
after2_group_dain_companion.groupAftermathCause: whose account the protagonist believed first in the gym, and why

after2_group_return.name: {name}
after2_group_return.text: *After the conversation, I pick up my bag and head toward the school gate.*

minsu_warn_1.name: {name}
minsu_warn_1.text: *Walking home. Just past the school gate when — Minsu falls in step behind me.*

minsu_warn_1_b.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_1_b.text: *He strides up and falls into step beside me.*

minsu_warn_4_b.name: {name}
minsu_warn_4_b.text: *Minsu keeps his eyes on the crosswalk signal beyond the school gate.*

hidden_nurse_d2_return.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_return.text: *I leave the nurse's office and return to the classroom, where the after-school light stretches across the desks.*

hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.text: *She discards the used cotton and presses the edge of the bandage once.* All done. If something besides the injury is bothering you, you can say it now.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.context: It is after school on Day 2, immediately after the nurse treated an injury from PE. The student has seen how attentive the school nurse is, and their trust has grown slightly. Treatment is complete; do not invent a new injury or diagnosis. They remain a school nurse and student, with professional boundaries intact.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is practical and observant, and she softens concern with light humor. She is caring without becoming overprotective and leaves choices about health and feelings to the student.

minsu_warn_6.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_6.text: One person at lunch, another after school. Must be fun for you. — Just saying. *He shrugs and walks ahead.*

after2_yuna_trap.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_trap.text: …I thought you meant me, not this place.

after2_yuna_trap_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_trap_react.text: *The bookmark moves one page forward. She puts the earbud lying at the edge of the sofa into her bag.*
